title: Pinch Me, Kiss Me, Kill Me: The Duckman Story
description: Private investigator, Duckman, must use his cunning and mastery of Jinkatsu to save the U.S. President.
quote: What is heroism? What is courage? Now, I don’t know if I can define them, but I do know them when I see them, and I see them both every time I look in the mirror.
altHero: live-action, human Duckman: a white man in a tuxedo

alt3: woman is tied up to a chair as human Duckman tries to free her, out the window is the Washington Monument
